dem.dataType: little-endian float32, row-major north to south
dem.originalResolution: 1 arcsecond, about 28 m E-W / 31 m N-S here; 40 m output sampling
dem.heightDatum: Skadi composite elevations; presumed SRTM EGM96 where SRTM is used; local datum not independently verified; visual sea plane Y=0
dem.modifications: Only visual surface: positive DEM clamped and tapered within ~85m of OSM coastline to Y=0; ocean set -3m; NOT a bathymetry dataset. Raw heights retained. Coastal distance is Euclidean raster distance ~14m, encoded at 4m quantization, clamped to 508m.
